messages.subject: Project Lyra — confirmatory IP due diligence
messages.plaintextBody:
Alan,

Could you confirm the status of the VQ-1, VQ-2 and VQ-3 families and run a freedom-to-operate screen within the defence/aerospace field? We need it to support the warranties in the licence. In particular please flag anything that should go into the disclosure letter — I understand VQ-3 has had a first examination report.

Elena Marchetti
Associate

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Lyra — confirmatory IP due diligence
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Our report is attached. Headlines: VQ-1 granted in GB/EP/US and the principal value driver; VQ-2 at national phase; VQ-3 pending with an answerable inventive-step objection (response due 8 November 2025). One EP right of possible relevance to VQ-2 which we do not consider infringed as configured. Three points for the disclosure letter, set out in section 5.

Alan Whitcombe
Hartington IP LLP
